name: clawd-emotes
title_zh: 像素小螃蟹动图，纯 SVG+CSS 不碰 GIF 帧
tagline_zh: 想要一只会举道具、戴帽子、有反应的像素螃蟹？不用逐帧画，CSS 关键帧让它在聊天里活起来，还能导出循环 GIF。
tagline_en: Want a pixel crab holding props, wearing hats, reacting? No frame-by-frame drawing—CSS keyframes bring it alive.
desc_en: Create original pixel-art "Clawd" crab emotes as pure SVG + CSS keyframe animations (no frame-by-frame GIFs, no raster sprites), and optionally export them to looping GIFs. Each emote is a tiny pixel crab doing an activity — holding a prop, wearing a hat, reacting — built from <rect>/<polygon>/<circle> and animated with @keyframes. Use this skill whenever the user wants to make, add, fix, or exten
why_zh: 用 <rect>/<polygon>/<circle> 搭螃蟹，@keyframes 做动画。
why_en: Built from rect/polygon/circle, animated via @keyframes—edit one line to change motion, ten times faster than hand-drawn frames.
limit_zh: 只认像素螃蟹造型，其他角色得自己改代码；动画只支持 CSS 关键帧，复杂物理效果做不了。
limit_en: Only pixel-crab shapes; other characters need code edits. CSS keyframes only—no complex physics. GIF export requires local ffmpeg.
title_en: Pixel crab emotes as pure SVG+CSS, no GIF frames
